elliot_customer: Hey, after rotating our API key we're seeing 401 invalid_api_key when calling v1/chat.completions. Worked with old key, new key returns 401.
elliot_customer: curl output: `HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized`
elliot_customer: We rotated via our CI (Vault) and updated ENV. No other changes. Any ideas? :confused:
sara_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact header you're sending (masking middle of key) or run a raw byte dump of the key so we can see hidden chars? Example: `echo -n "$NEW_KEY" | xxd -p`
elliot_customer: Sure, pasted masked header: `Authorization: Bearer rwd_live_abc123…xyz`
elliot_customer: xxd output: `e2 80 8d 72 77 64 5f 6c 69 76 65 5f 61 62 63 31 32 33 2e 2e 2e 78 79 7a`
elliot_customer: Not sure what that `e2 80 8d` is at the start.
sara_support: That byte sequence is UTF-8 for ZERO WIDTH JOINER (U+200D) — looks like an invisible character got prepended when the key was copied into the CI secret. :facepalm.
sara_support: Can you temporarily try trimming hidden unicode from the value to confirm? e.g. `python -c "import sys; print(sys.stdin.read().strip().replace('\u200d',''))" <<< "$NEW_KEY" | xxd -p`
elliot_customer: Ran it — after stripping U+200D curl succeeds and requests return 200. So that's the issue.
elliot_customer: This happened when we copied the key from an iMessage thread into Vault; I guess the selection inserted the ZWJ when emoji were nearby.
jon_mliaison: Noted — this pattern can occur copying from chat apps or PDFs. We should add a note to the docs and a small CI lint rule to reject non-printable/unicode control chars in API keys.
rotation-bot: automated note: key rwd_live_abc123…xyz rotated by elliot_customer at 2026-03-17T14:07:00Z
sara_support: For remediation: (1) Regenerate key if you prefer, (2) Or sanitize before storing: `printf "%s" "$KEY" | tr -d '\u200d'` or use the python snippet above, (3) Add a Vault pre-write validation to fail on non-ascii bytes.
elliot_customer: Thanks — we sanitized and updated vault rules. All good now. Appreciate the quick help :tada:
